3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Heart - For Mom-Standard / Mini

The 3D Memory Crystal™ Heart for Mom from Beyond Memories® turns your favorite photo of Mom into a heart-shaped sculpture of optical glass that catches the light in every room she walks into. Whether you're shopping for Mother's Day, her birthday, a milestone anniversary, or simply a Sunday surprise, this is the keepsake she will keep on her bedside table or windowsill for the rest of her life - because every time the sun hits it, she sees the face that matters most. Your photo of Mom (or you with Mom, or your kids with their grandmother) is sculpted into a true three-dimensional model and engraved deep inside a solid block of K9 optical crystal using a precision 4K subsurface laser. The result is unmistakable: a portrait suspended inside clear glass, depth you can feel from every angle, and details that no flat print can replicate. The work is done by real artists at our Las Vegas studio - not algorithms. K9 optical crystal - the same lead-free glass used in laboratory optics, hand-polished to a flawless finish True 3D subsurface engraving - your photo is sculpted in three dimensions and laser-etched inside the crystal, not printed on the surface 4K HD upgrade - available on every size for the highest level of facial detail Five sizes - Mini, Small, Medium, Large, and XL to match her space Free photo enhancement - our in-house artists clean up your photo before engraving (no extra cost) Beyond Memories Light Base compatible - sold separately, illuminates the engraving from below in eight LED colors Premium gift-ready box - ships in a satin-lined presentation box ready to hand to Mom U.S. studio + U.S. customer support - Las Vegas based, real humans on the phone Perfect for Mom, every occasion The Heart for Mom keepsake fits a lifetime of moments - not just one. Mother's Day is the obvious one, and we ship thousands of these in the weeks leading up to the second Sunday of May. But Mom's birthday lands beautifully here too: pair the crystal with her favorite cake and a handwritten card and you will see her face change the moment she sees her grandchildren engraved in glass. For milestone moments - her 50th, her 60th, your wedding day, the day she became a grandmother - a heart-shaped crystal feels like an heirloom from the moment it leaves your hands. And for the quietest occasions - a Christmas she didn't expect, a Sunday lunch, the day after her chemo ended - it is the gift that says "I see you" without needing words. Mothers who have lost their own mothers tell us this gift takes on another layer entirely. How the personalization works Pick the size that fits her space (Mini sits on a bedside table, Large anchors a mantel, XL becomes a centerpiece). Upload one favorite photo of Mom - or you with Mom, or her grandkids - through our simple uploader. Our in-house photo team gently cleans up the background, balances the lighting, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We then convert the photo into a true three-dimensional model and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to sculpt the portrait inside the K9 optical crystal. The engraving is permanent, will never fade, will never peel, and lives inside the glass - not on top of it. The full process from upload to ship typically takes 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout if you need it sooner. What photo works best The heart shape is gentle on portraits and looks best with a single subject or two subjects framed close. A clear, well-lit headshot of Mom against any simple background works beautifully (we will remove the background for you). A photo of you with Mom, foreheads almost touching, makes for an unforgettable engraving. A grandparent-with-grandchild shot works wonderfully - the more emotional connection visible on the faces, the more powerful the crystal. Avoid extreme close-ups where only a partial face is visible, photos with heavy filters or beauty smoothing that have erased detail, and group shots with more than 4 people (faces will be small inside the heart shape). When in doubt, send us 2-3 options after you order and our team will recommend which one will engrave best. What's in the box Every Heart for Mom ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The box is designed for direct gifting - she opens the box and the crystal is the first thing she sees, cradled in soft satin against a dark linen lining. If you order with our Memory Light Base (sold separately), the base ships in its own protective sleeve and slots cleanly into the same gift box for a unified presentation. Crystal care K9 optical crystal is incredibly durable but rewards a little kindness. Display the crystal away from direct sunlight in a high-traffic spot like a mantel, bookshelf, or bedside table. Dust gently once a month with the included microfiber polishing cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a tiny amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). If you use a Memory Light Base, simply lift the crystal off and wipe both pieces separately. Keep away from extreme heat or chemical contact and your crystal will look exactly the same in 30 years as it does today. Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days after your order. Express shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination, with rates calculated at checkout. Frequently asked questions Will Mom see her own face clearly inside the crystal? Yes. The 4K HD subsurface laser engraving captures facial detail with photographic clarity. She will recognize the photo instantly - and so will anyone else who sees the crystal. Can I send a photo where Mom is wearing glasses or a hat? Absolutely. Hats, glasses, jewelry, scarves - whatever makes Mom look like Mom is exactly what we want to capture. What if the photo is older and a little blurry? Send it anyway. Our photo team can often restore older images. If we cannot get the photo to engraving quality, we will reach out before production starts to discuss options. Do I need to buy the Light Base? No - the crystal looks beautiful on its own. The Light Base (sold separately) adds eight LED colors that illuminate the engraving from below, making the portrait glow in low light. Most customers add it when buying for a parent or grandparent. What if Mom doesn't love it? We have a 30-day satisfaction promise. If the engraving doesn't capture the moment the way you imagined, we will rework it at no cost or refund the order. Is this a good gift for a mom who has lost her own mother? Yes - many of our most cherished orders are heart crystals engraved with a photo of the grandmother who is no longer here. The K9 glass tradition of preserving a portrait inside light is, for many families, exactly the comfort needed.
